name: Pai
blurb: Pai is a mountain town in northern Thailand known for a hippie vibe, jungle enduro dirt bike trails, and the Big White Buddha. Recent discussions also note local-foreigner tensions regarding Israeli populations and reports of a magnitude 4.6 earthquake.

positive: Described as a beautiful, serene mountain town with a hippie vibe
Features the Big White Buddha and scenic sunset photography
Offers jungle dirt bike enduro trails
negative: Reports of local-foreigner tensions and disputed numbers of Israeli visitors
Mention of a 4.6 magnitude earthquake near the area
References to a crazy, winding road from Chiang Mai to Pai
